relevance_to_analysis.prop_242_forestry: Forestry sector contributes ~2.4% of GDP and ~SEK 140 bn/year in exports. Economic significance justifies some regulatory simplification, but Sweden's fiscal space (debt 36.6% of GDP) means there is no austerity pressure to sacrifice environmental protection for economic output.
relevance_to_analysis.prop_246_youth_crime: Sweden's GDP growth (2.1% 2026F) and low government debt (36.6% of GDP) provide fiscal space for Kriminalvården capacity expansion needed to implement prop. 246. However, the constitutional risk (Lagrådet) is not an economic risk — it is a governance risk.
